issue.title: [Bug] File tools reject an absolute path that is inside the project through a symlink

steps: Create target.txt with hello. Create a uniquely named symlink under /tmp that points to the current project directory, and report its absolute path.
Use read_file to read target.txt through the absolute symlink alias of the project. Do not read a different file or change the project configuration.
expected: An absolute path resolving to a file within the project is handled consistently with the real project path.
defect: The lexical absolute-path check rejects an alias whose real target is inside the project.
Root cause: isValidFilePath compares the supplied absolute path prefix against the project root before symlink-aware resolution can establish that the target is contained. The issue also involves a symlinked project root; the alias fixture tests that same lexical/real-path boundary.

_meta.notes: No adapter cwd change is made. The explicit alias outside the lexical root is an adaptation of the issue symlinked-root setup and needs later runtime acceptance; it must not be described as a verbatim original reproduction.
_meta.version_installation_validation: not_executed; historical launch and dependency compatibility must be checked before running
